run.config:
DATALOADER:
  NUM_INSTANCE: 4
  NUM_WORKERS: 4
  SAMPLER: softmax_triplet
DATASETS:
  NAMES: MSVR310
  ROOT_DIR: /data/gaob/Re-ID/dataset
INPUT:
  PADDING: 10
  PIXEL_MEAN:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PIXEL_STD:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PROB: 0.5
  RE_PROB: 0.5
  SIZE_TEST:
  - 128
  - 256
  SIZE_TRAIN:
  - 128
  - 256
MODEL:
  ADAPTER: false
  ATM: true
  ATT_DROP_RATE: 0.0
  DEVICE: cuda
  DEVICE_ID: '0'
  DIRECT: 0
  DIST_TRAIN: false
  DROP_OUT: 0.0
  DROP_PATH: 0.1
  FROZEN: false
  GLOBAL_LOCAL: true
  HDM: true
  HEAD: 8
  ID_LOSS_TYPE: softmax
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  IF_LABELSMOOTH: 'on'
  IF_WITH_CENTER: 'no'
  METRIC_LOSS_TYPE: triplet
  NAME: DeMo
  NECK: bnneck
  NO_MARGIN: true
  PRETRAIN_PATH_T: /data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt
  PROMPT: false
  SIE_CAMERA: true
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  SIE_VIEW: false
  STRIDE_SIZE:
  - 16
  - 16
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: ViT-B-16
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
OUTPUT_DIR: ..
SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.00035
  BIAS_LR_FACTOR: 2
  CENTER_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.0005
  CENTER_LR: 0.5
  CHECKPOINT_PERIOD: 10
  CLUSTER_MARGIN: 0.3
  COSINE_MARGIN: 0.5
  COSINE_SCALE: 30
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  LARGE_FC_LR: false
  LOG_PERIOD: 10
  MARGIN: 0.3
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  MOMENTUM: 0.9
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: Adam
  RANGE_ALPHA: 0
  RANGE_BETA: 1
  RANGE_K: 2
  RANGE_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1
  RANGE_MARGIN: 0.3
  SEED: 42
  STEPS:
  - 40
  - 70
  WARMUP_FACTOR: 0.01
  WARMUP_ITERS: 10
  WARMUP_METHOD: linear
  WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.0001
  WEIGHT_DECAY_BIAS: 0.0001
TEST:
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  MISS: nothing
  NECK_FEAT: before
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
run.pretraining: Corresponding original DeMo official50 best plus additional50/freshAdam; identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: Exactly the R201C narrow5120 identity-coordinate expert; no new loss, metric or gate
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.

run.checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
run.evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
run.selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
run.method_revision: User order: three datasets normal full-official results first; missing evaluation afterwards. Same R201C narrow5120 expert/outlet/loss/augmentation across datasets, original50 anchor plus extra50. No dataset-specific method or checkpoint rule; benchmark maximum mAP/earliest ties. RGBNT201 normal narrow two controls already completed; remaining MSVR310/RGBNT100 two controls.
run.partial_training: Matched available-source DeMo; one uniformly sampled proper modality set per batch; stopped full-view gallery, same shared identity interface and original partial CE/triplet weights
run.amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
run.retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files
